stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon
stories.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model it claims delivers frontier-level intelligence for complex software engineering and science workflows. The model ranks third on the Artificial Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level, trailing larger, slower models. It is now available via the company API.

stories.title: Google prices Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million tokens
stories.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, promising frontier-level intelligence for complex workflows. The model is available through the API at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. This pricing sits above the introductory rates for the company's Carbon and Argon models.

stories.title: Google expands Gemini 4 lineup with Neon
stories.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, a medium-sized model designed to bridge the gap between its highest intelligence and highest efficiency offerings. Demis Hassabis described the new addition as alchemy at its finest. The company continues to roll out models in an effort to retake the top spot.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with Opus 5.5-level coding performance at 25% lower API token prices - VentureBeat
Gemini 4 Neon targets faster coding performance
stories.summary: Google has launched Gemini 4 Neon, claiming the model delivers performance comparable to its larger Carbon model at three times the speed and 60 percent of the cost. The model is designed for debugging large codebases and coordinating multiple agents to complete complex projects.

stories.title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Neon for Complex AI Work - The Defiant
Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon for enterprise workloads
stories.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model it describes as delivering frontier-level intelligence at a lower cost per task. It ranks third on the Artificial Intelligence Index and second on the Vals Index. The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens for developers.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Neon joins the Google model family
stories.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, a model offering frontier-level reasoning for high-frequency workflows. The company claims the model matches or exceeds the quality of its Carbon model while operating at Flash speeds. It is now available for use within the Gemini application.

stories.title: Google's Gemini agent now shares a name with its 8-year-old to-do app - PPC Land
Google updates Gemini Task mode
stories.summary: Google is updating the Task mode of its Gemini artificial intelligence assistant to improve performance on multistep projects. The feature allows the assistant to handle tasks such as booking appointments and comparing product listings. The update is being detailed by vice president Josh Woodward.

stories.title: Google makes Gemini Tasks feature free
stories.summary: Google is making its Gemini Tasks feature free for users in six countries, expanding access beyond paid subscribers. The tool is designed to handle multi-step projects and recurring routines in the background. The company is attempting to transition Gemini from a chatbot into an active assistant.

stories.title: ResearchMonkey AI bundles research tools
stories.summary: ResearchMonkey AI has launched a subscription service that combines more than 40 research tools and several large language models into a single account. The platform routes tasks to the model it considers best suited for the work, with paid plans starting at $9.99 a month.

stories.title: Scotiabank deploys AI agents for credit processing
stories.summary: Scotiabank has launched an AI-powered tool called Commercial Navigator to assist its credit processing team. The bank claims the tool reduced the time required for financial statement analysis from one hour to less than a minute. The bank aims to reclaim administrative time by 2027.

stories.title: Chargebee launches AI agents for finance tasks
stories.summary: Chargebee has introduced its Arc platform, featuring AI agents designed to handle contract ingestion, receivables, and revenue recognition. The system logs every step with its author and rationale, requiring human review before actions are committed. The agents are intended to automate routine finance department workflows.

stories.title: Daydream launches AI personal shopping agent
stories.summary: Daydream has released an autonomous shopping agent that allows users to discover and purchase items from retail partners. CEO Julie Bornstein stated the market opportunity is significant because software has historically struggled with taste. The agent accepts descriptions via text or visual inspiration.

stories.title: Nutrient launches document extraction API
stories.summary: Nutrient has released an API designed to extract data from PDFs, scans, and images into structured JSON or Markdown. The tool provides confidence scores and bounding boxes for extracted values to address errors in document processing. It is available as a hosted service.

stories.title: IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai Launch AI Kavach, India’s First AI Cybersecurity Lab for the Financial Sector - India Educatio
Siemens launches AI engineering agent in India
stories.summary: Siemens has launched its Eigen Engineering Agent in India, designed to automate PLC coding and device configuration. The company says the tool uses multi-step reasoning and self-correction to work within existing systems. It has been piloted with 16 customers. Industrial standards are now being automated by software.

stories.title: India records 25.5 billion app downloads in 2025
stories.summary: India recorded 25.5 billion app downloads in 2025, more than double the United States, according to Sensor Tower data. Generative AI app downloads reached 600 million in the same period. The market for intelligent apps is expanding, and the search for where to build them continues.

stories.title: Ka-Naada Phonetics debuts universal Indic keyboard
stories.summary: Ka-Naada Phonetics has introduced a hardware keyboard supporting multiple Indian languages through a single layout. The company aims to help regional vendors and small-business owners operate AI chatbots in their mother tongues. Language has long been a barrier to digital adoption, and now there is a keyboard.

stories.title: GitHub offers local data residency for Indian enterprises
stories.summary: GitHub is providing local data residency options for enterprise customers in India ahead of the May 2027 DPDP Rules deadline. The move aims to assist sectors with strict data location requirements, including government and finance. Compliance is becoming a service that can be hosted locally.

stories.title: Couchbase opens Bengaluru AI Centre of Excellence
stories.summary: Couchbase has opened an AI Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru to help enterprises move agentic AI from experimentation into production. The new APAC headquarters will support hiring across engineering and product functions. The company aims to bring its engineering teams and customers closer together to operationalise AI.

stories.title: IIT Kanpur launches AI security lab
stories.summary: IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai have launched AI Kavach, a cybersecurity lab dedicated to securing financial AI systems. The lab arrives as AI agents increasingly execute transactions and make credit decisions with minimal human oversight. Financial systems are being secured against the agents they have already deployed.

stories.title: MeitY launches VoicERA voice AI stack
stories.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has launched VoicERA, an open-source voice AI stack deployed on the BHASHINI infrastructure. The platform is designed to be pluggable and interoperable to reduce vendor lock-in across government and research ecosystems. A national execution layer has been added to language AI.

stories.title: AI and surgery in Indian epilepsy care
stories.summary: Epilepsy affects an estimated 10 to 12 million people in India, with rural prevalence double that of cities. New approaches include AI-powered diagnosis, wearable seizure monitors and advanced brain surgery. While 70 percent of patients can become seizure-free with medicine, treatment gaps remain wide.

stories.title: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs raises $47 million
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A round comprising equity and debt. The startup plans to use the funds to build deployment-readiness infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea and India. It also intends to expand its R&D presence in London, San Francisco and Seoul.

stories.title: YC-backed LATO raises €4.28 million to automate and accelerate commercial due diligence with AI agents - EU-Startups
Dreamteam raises $53 million for AI-native CRM
stories.summary: Dreamteam has secured $53 million to challenge Salesforce and HubSpot with an AI-native CRM. The platform uses a Company Brain to draw on emails and meetings to build a shared record of customer relationships. Four AI agents then draft follow-ups and flag deal risks for sales teams.

stories.title: Soket AI Labs secures seed funding
stories.summary: Finvolve and India Accelerator have invested in Soket AI Labs to advance its frontier research and indigenous language models. The Bengaluru-based lab is focused on developing models for math, code and reasoning. The investment will support the development of sovereign AI solutions for mission-critical sectors.

stories.title: Bajaj Finserv and Pennant invest in Soket AI
stories.summary: Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies have invested $4 million in Bengaluru-based Soket AI. The startup is developing indigenous language models to help banks process sensitive customer data. The investment will support the company as it explores enterprise applications for its models.

stories.title: Genesis AI raises $500 million
stories.summary: French robotics startup Genesis AI has raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation. Investors include Khosla Ventures, Nvidia and Eric Schmidt. The company plans to use the capital to increase production of its general-purpose robot, Eno, and expand its AI training capabilities.

stories.title: IIT Delhi graduate shares career journey
stories.summary: Yash Garg, an IIT Delhi graduate, shared his transition from a corporate role at Google to founding his own startup. His initial career path was redirected by the need to help his family repay over 1 crore in debt. Personal history remains a factor in professional trajectories.

stories.title: AI startup Manifast secures investment
stories.summary: Manifast, an operator of an AI-powered planning workspace, has secured investment from the Alchemist accelerator and the University of Chicago. The startup was selected for the program after beating 40-to-1 odds. It plans to participate in the local program for six months.

stories.title: OpenAI and AMD report chip design gains
stories.summary: OpenAI says its AI models reduced AMD's chip design process from one year to under five months. The collaboration achieved 14 percent improvements in power, performance, and area by rewriting SystemVerilog RTL code. AMD independently verified the results, which are now being incorporated into future hardware designs.

stories.title: OpenAI claims chip design progress
stories.summary: OpenAI says its AI models delivered up to 14 percent improvements in chip design performance, power, and area for AMD. The company described the collaboration as achieving a year of progress in less than five months. Some model-generated changes are already included in designs sent for manufacturing.

stories.title: Structured prompts improve AI beam design accuracy
stories.summary: Researchers found that structured prompting can increase the computational correctness of large language models in reinforced concrete beam design from 37 percent to 90 percent. The study, published in the International Journal of Concrete Structures and Materials, evaluated models on structural performance calculations for simply supported cross sections.

stories.title: Researchers look to reinforcement learning for AI reasoning
stories.summary: Researchers are increasingly using reinforcement learning to improve how large language models reason, solve problems, and follow instructions. The approach moves beyond simple next-word prediction, as developers seek to guarantee meaningful improvements in intelligence that larger training datasets alone no longer provide.

stories.title: Medical education AI research sees surge
stories.summary: A bibliometric analysis reveals that scholarly research on AI in medical education expanded exponentially between 2021 and 2026. The study mapped 2,298 peer-reviewed publications, noting that the field remained a niche area of inquiry for two decades before the recent surge in activity.

stories.title: Sports medicine AI research lacks clinical validation
stories.summary: A study of 284 articles published between 2019 and 2026 shows rapid growth in AI sports medicine research. While technical output has surged, the findings indicate the field remains distant from widespread clinical adoption due to a lack of external validation and prospective evidence.

OpenAI links model releases to safety reviews
stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced a framework requiring safety reviews before frontier models advance from research to deployment. The company says its Control Room can halt model output within 35 seconds. A September incident involved failed automatic stops and delayed human intervention despite monitoring alerts.

stories.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment - OpenAI
How Alibaba and Megaspeed accessed restricted Nvidia AI chips - Israel Hayom
Nvidia stops shipping US-approved AI chips to China - Gulf Business
Nvidia discloses $118 billion in infrastructure guarantees
stories.summary: Nvidia reported $107.6 billion in data center revenue and disclosed $118 billion in financial guarantees for AI infrastructure projects. The largest guarantee supports a campus in Ohio intended to host 4.25 gigawatts of capacity. The company expects the first buildings to come online in fiscal 2029.

stories.title: Nvidia reports record quarterly revenue
stories.summary: Nvidia announced third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103 percent increase year-over-year. Data center revenue reached $107.6 billion, while edge computing grew 42 percent to $8.2 billion. The company reported a gross margin of 74.8 percent for the period ending October 25, 2026.

stories.title: How Nvidia Chips Ended Up Within Reach of China’s Military - The New York Times
Nvidia funds new chip packaging lines
stories.summary: Nvidia is financing production lines at SPIL to handle interposer wafer fabrication, bumping, and testing. The agreement marks a move to fund a second source for the front-end of AI chip packages. Neither company has disclosed the licensing or specific manufacturing methods for the interposers.

stories.title: Nvidia ends H200 chip sales to China
stories.summary: Acting CEO Colette Kress confirmed that Nvidia will no longer sell H200 chips to China. The company previously produced China-specific versions of its cards to comply with US export restrictions. The US government has also introduced new rules limiting remote access to advanced AI servers.

stories.title: Nvidia halts H200 shipments to China
stories.summary: Nvidia is abandoning H200 chip exports to China, reversing a previous deal that allowed sales to approved customers under a 25 percent export tariff. Interim CEO Colette Kress confirmed the pause during the company's third-quarter earnings call. No official reason for the cessation was provided.

stories.title: Nvidia reports rising debt alongside record sales
stories.summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103 percent from a year earlier. Despite the growth, inventory rose 86 percent and debt has more than quadrupled since January. The company is currently navigating a leadership transition following the departure of co-founder Jensen Huang.

stories.title: Moving from AI experimentation to adoption
stories.summary: Dentons held a discussion in Scotland on transitioning from AI experimentation to responsible adoption. Panellists from various professional backgrounds shared insights on the shift, noting that while AI is changing work patterns, organisations are still navigating the practical requirements of meaningful and responsible implementation.

stories.title: IRDAI flags AI risks in insurance
stories.summary: Nearly 85% of insurance companies now use AI, according to IRDAI. Officials have raised concerns regarding whether these models are adequately trained for local economic conditions and policyholder behaviour. The regulator also questioned if humans remain in charge of final decisions as technology introduces new risks.

stories.title: Domain expertise remains relevant in the AI era
stories.summary: Industry leaders at TechSparks 2026 discussed the role of human judgement in software development. While AI allows non-coders to build prototypes, experts noted that turning those ideas into reliable products still requires domain knowledge and engineering skills. Knowing what to build remains the primary challenge.

stories.title: NetApp Excellerator startup focuses on AI intent
stories.summary: Wald.ai is developing security tools to help enterprises monitor what employees input into generative AI models. While legacy systems focus on pattern matching, the company aims to interpret user intent to prevent the leakage of proprietary source code and financial projections during automated tasks.

stories.title: Public Relations Society of India hosts AI conclave
stories.summary: The Public Relations Society of India recently held a national conclave in New Delhi to discuss the impact of AI on communication. The event explored how the technology is redefining the public relations industry, featuring perspectives from journalists and academics on the evolving professional landscape.

stories.title: Cato Networks introduces AgentSense for AI security
stories.summary: Cato Networks has launched AgentSense, a security capability for its SASE platform designed to intervene before AI agents perform harmful actions. The company says the tool allows enterprises to grant agents greater autonomy over critical business processes while maintaining oversight of their operations.

stories.title: Reva.AI releases security tool for coding agents
stories.summary: Reva.AI has launched a security product for AI coding agents that provides visibility into automated actions like file editing and command execution. The system evaluates agent activity against established policies and records actions in an audit log to assist security teams with oversight.

stories.title: Spider Networks launches instruction library for AI agents
stories.summary: Spider Networks has released KUKURI, a web service providing instruction libraries for AI agents and chat tools. The platform allows users to customise how AI systems respond and complete tasks, offering templates for activities ranging from email sorting to website design for non-technical users.

stories.title: Fintech news network overview
Trump rejects global AI regulation
stories.summary: President Donald Trump stated that the United States opposes globalist regulation of artificial intelligence. Speaking in Shenzhen, he described AI as super intelligence and warned that international governance could hinder the country in its technology race with China. He noted that the technology requires careful management.

stories.title: Watch Trump Argues Against Global Regulation of AI - Bloomberg.com
US opposes global AI governance
stories.summary: President Donald Trump told APEC leaders in Shenzhen that the United States will not accept globalist regulation of artificial intelligence. The stance complicates upcoming talks with Beijing on AI risk, as Washington simultaneously implements new restrictions on cross-border access to advanced computing chips.

stories.title: US cites competition in opposition to AI regulation
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced that the United States opposes international efforts to regulate artificial intelligence. Speaking at the APEC summit in China, he argued that global controls could put the US at a disadvantage compared to China in the development of the technology.

stories.title: US Opposes Global AI Regulation, Citing Competition Concerns - Hamro Patro
Trump reiterates opposition to AI regulation
stories.summary: President Donald Trump stated that the US opposes any form of globalist regulation for artificial intelligence. Ahead of a meeting with President Xi Jinping, Trump warned that broad international frameworks could stifle American progress in the technology race against China.

stories.title: Trump says he opposes 'globalist' AI regulation during APEC Summit - marketscreener.com
Trump warns against robust AI regulation
stories.summary: President Donald Trump told leaders at the APEC summit that the US will not allow robust regulation of super intelligence, arguing it would stifle development. The comments follow the introduction of new US restrictions on access to advanced AI technology.

research.title: A Hybrid RAG Framework for Deceptive Review Detection: Integrating RoBERTa-LoRA, FAISS-Based Retrieval, and LLM Reasoning
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The growth of deceptive online opinions poses a critical risk of misinformation and fraud. This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to automatically distinguish spam reviews. The architecture integrates RoBERTa with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) classification. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of In-Context Learning and Out-of-Context Hallucination
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can infer and follow specific rules through in-context learning (ICL), yet may fail to remain faithful to provided evidence, giving rise to out-of-context (OOC) hallucination. Existing work has largely investigated the underlying mechanisms. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Beyond Replacement: Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a flexible alternative to autoregressive models, enabling any-order infilling. While most existing decoding methods treat decoded tokens as fixed, some recent models allow previously decoded tokens to be revised only by. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: BiMa-ECGSR: reconstructing the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with bidirectional state-space models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Wearables and monitors record few electrocardiogram (ECG) leads, most diagnostic tools assume 12 leads. BiMa-ECGSR reconstructs the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder--decoder, as regression (BiMa-SR) or diffusion (DiBiMa-SR). Models. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Biologically-Inspired Spike Encoding and Optimization for Spiking Neural Networks
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer theoretical energy-efficiency advantages over conventional deep networks, but realizing these advantages on vision tasks requires sparse spike representations that naive rate-coding methods fail to provide. We combine biologically motivated spike-encoding schemes. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Can LLMs Understand What They Predict? Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference in Financial Markets
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated through their ability to predict future outcomes, implicitly assuming that predictive success reflects an understanding of the underlying system. However, accurate predictions can often be achieved without recovering the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
